recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Future work should not re-open FHIR-26312 unless the work group wants to revisit the nearest-repetition rule; any small spelling cleanup such as equadistant/equidistant is editorial and outside this reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-26312 asked FHIR-I to clarify whether Questionnaire.item.enableWhen can reference a question inside a repeating group from outside that group, and resolved to disallow ambiguous repeated-question references while documenting any-answer matching and enableWhenExpression for more specific repeated-answer logic.
initial_application: Commit 5665c38fcfbab7630b6f50f421947fcf41581117 applied FHIR-26312 by adding repeated-question ambiguity/error text to Questionnaire.item.enableWhen.question and multiple-answer/enableWhenExpression guidance to Questionnaire.item.enableWhen.answer[x].
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread and 2020-04-30 SDC minutes support the same interpretation: references into repeating groups should not rely on ambiguous nearest-repetition behavior and should use enableWhenExpression for complex repeated-instance logic. FHIR-26993 clarified nearby enableWhen/enableBehavior wording and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini lists Questionnaire as an active resource, and source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml already states that ambiguous same-linkId repeated question references are an error, recommends enableWhenExpression, and says multiple answers satisfy enableWhen when any answer matches.
